answer: Design against the marginal clone, not against the average user. Require a minimum elapsed time, not a minimum amount of work, before an identity can be counted. with a jade floor, ledge stops helping, so vault equalises rich and poor attackers at the same wall. the attacker cannot compress the schedule, which caps fleet turnover at the rate the network ages its members.
